rationale: Builds on the 2026_04_25 staged reverse-tail recurrence baseline. The embedded payload is the current best script with one surgical export-budget change: recurrent-tail FP16 keep now preserves attention Q and V for recurrent tail blocks, plus final-block K, instead of Q/K plus final-block V. This spends the same tail float budget on value content for the penultimate recurrent block while keeping the final block Q/K/V protected. VAL_LOSS_EVERY remains 0, MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS remains 600, and the final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact evaluation path is retained.
title: Penultimate Recurrent V FP16 Reallocation
